tool_args.rationale: The evidence supports co-activation of the sink-coupled base and dual-horizon adaptation, but all existing rows are short-horizon while the target H is 20.4. The supplied mechanism notes specifically identify a slow-horizon probe as the discriminating measurement needed before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon sink-coupled model using the five short-horizon rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot horizons stop at 0.48, leaving slow adaptation and the forecast behavior at H=20.4 poorly identified.
More fine-grained short-horizon data would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity as directly.
It is irrelevant to identifying the stated temporal mechanism and is explicitly discouraged.
